community_notes: Discard a Miracle die from the pool to substitute its value for a single roll/test. Modeled with the pooled-resource `replace-roll-from-pool` effect (the dice-substitution sub-shape); the cruncher leaves this unsupported (fail-safe) since pool state is not tracked by the buff layer. Previously punted as a roll-modifier guarantee-crit, which over-claimed a deterministic auto-6 per activation.

name: Symphonic Payload
community_notes: Re-roll the dice that determine the random Attacks characteristic of the bearer's weapon (modeled as re-roll all).

name: Fervent Purgation

name: Righteous Purpose
community_notes: [APPROX] In your Command phase, select up to 3 ADEPTA SORORITAS units; they are Righteous until the start of your next Command phase (modeled as 'turn'), gaining +1" Move and +1 Leadership. The +1 WS/BS for Battle Sisters Squad / Celestian Sacresants / Paragon Warsuits models and the +1 OC for non-Battle-shocked Celestian Sacresants are not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Boundless Zeal
community_notes: The unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back; Penitent units are eligible to shoot and declare a charge instead.

name: Devout Fanaticism
community_notes: Used in your opponent's Shooting phase just after an enemy unit has shot at your unit.

name: Final Redemption
community_notes: Used on a Penitent unit that was just destroyed while within range of an objective marker you controlled: that objective remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

name: Lash of Guilt
community_notes: Used just before the unit Advances. Penitent Engines units do not make an Advance roll; instead add 6" to their Move characteristic until the end of the phase.

name: Passion of the Penitent
community_notes: Only attacks made by Penitent models in the unit benefit.

name: Purity of Suffering
community_notes: Only Penitent models in the unit gain the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

name: Divine Intervention
community_notes: You can discard 1-3 Miracle dice when using this Stratagem; the model returns with D3 wounds remaining plus 1 per Miracle dice discarded (up to its starting wounds), unengaged, not part of an Attached unit, with a Starting Strength of 1. Saint Celestine cannot be selected; the same Character cannot be selected more than once per battle.

name: Praise the Fallen
community_notes: Used in your opponent's Shooting phase just after an enemy unit has shot and destroyed one or more models in your unit; your unit must target only that enemy unit, and only if it is an eligible target.

name: Sanctified Immolation
community_notes: Used on a Vehicle model with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed: do not roll for Deadly Demise; mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.

name: Spirit of the Martyr
community_notes: Each destroyed model that has not fought this phase fights after the attacking unit finishes its attacks and is then removed from play.

name: Suffering and Sacrifice
community_notes: Used at the start of the Fight phase on one Infantry or Walker unit: until the end of the phase, each enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit must select your unit as the target of its attacks.

name: Blazing Ire
community_notes: Used in your opponent's Shooting phase just after an enemy unit has shot at your Transport: one embarked unit can disembark as if it were your Movement phase, then shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, targeting only the attacking enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).

name: Carry Forth the Faithful
community_notes: Used just before the Transport Advances: re-roll its Advance rolls, and units can disembark from it even though it Advanced. Units that do so count as having made a Normal move and cannot declare a charge this turn.

name: Cleansing Flames
community_notes: Targets one unit that has not been selected to shoot this phase; only Torrent weapons gain [Devastating Wounds].

name: Righteous Blows
community_notes: If one or more enemy models are destroyed by those weapons this phase, one destroyed model's unit must take a Battle-shock test (rider not encoded).

name: Rites of Fire
community_notes: Ranged attacks only, against enemy units within 6" that are also within range of an objective marker (target conditions not encoded). If enemy models are destroyed by those attacks, one destroyed model's unit must take a Battle-shock test (rider not encoded).

name: Shield of Aversion
community_notes: Lasts until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.

name: Bastion of Faith
community_notes: If your unit is Righteous, you can also select one other Celestian Sacresants unit (not Battle-shocked, within 6") to receive the same protection (extension not encoded).

name: Indefatigable Dedication
community_notes: Used just after the unit Falls Back. If the unit is Righteous, it is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back instead (escalation not encoded).

name: Path of the Righteous
community_notes: If the unit is Righteous, those moves do not need to end closer to the closest enemy model, provided they end as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (relaxation not encoded).

name: Shield of Denial
community_notes: Used just after a mortal wound is allocated to the unit. If the unit is Righteous, the Feel No Pain is 5+ against mortal wounds instead (escalation not encoded).

name: Suffer Not the Unfaithful
community_notes: The unit must be Righteous and not have been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

name: To the Heart of Heresy
community_notes: If the unit is Righteous, also improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of its melee weapons by 1 until the end of the phase (rider not encoded).

name: Angelic Descent
community_notes: Used at the end of your opponent's Fight phase: remove the unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

name: Blinding Radiance
community_notes: Targets one Infantry unit that was selected as a target, or one friendly Jump Pack unit within 3" of such a unit. If a Jump Pack unit was targeted, friendly Infantry units within 3" of it also impose -1 to Hit (extension not encoded).

name: Divine Guidance
community_notes: If one or more enemy models are destroyed by those attacks, you gain 1 Miracle dice (rider not encoded).

name: Faith and Fury
community_notes: If one or more enemy models are destroyed by the unit's attacks this phase, you gain 1 Miracle dice (rider not encoded).

name: Light of the Emperor
community_notes: The blessed unit can ignore modifiers to its models' profile characteristics, its weapons' WS/BS, and any roll or test made for it (excluding saving throw modifiers). If the unit has the Jump Pack keyword, friendly Adepta Sororitas units within 3" are also blessed (extension not encoded).

name: Shield of Faith
community_notes: Used just after the unit suffers a mortal wound; can instead target one friendly Jump Pack unit within 3" of it, in which case friendly Adepta Sororitas units within 3" of that unit also gain the Feel No Pain (extension not encoded).

name: Fervent Devotion
community_notes: Used when the unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move: that move does not prevent it from being eligible to shoot or declare a charge.

name: Fires of Damnation
community_notes: Used when the unit is selected to shoot or fight: its Torrent weapons have an Attacks characteristic of 6, and all of its attacks improve their Armour Penetration by 1.

name: Take Cover
community_notes: Used when an enemy unit targets your unit while it is within a terrain area; Arco-flagellants units cannot be selected.

name: Psalm of Righteous Judgement
community_notes: While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time an enemy unit is destroyed by a Penitent unit from your army, you can discard 1 Miracle dice and then gain 1 Miracle dice showing a value of 6.

name: Verse of Holy Piety
community_notes: Once per battle, at the start of the battle round, select one Vow of Atonement (see the Desperate for Redemption detachment rule): until the start of the next battle round it is active for the bearer's unit in addition to any active for your army, even if already selected this battle.

name: Catechism of Divine Penitence
community_notes: Canoness, Palatine or Ministorum Priest model only.

name: Saintly Example
community_notes: When the bearer is destroyed, you gain an additional D3 Miracle dice.

name: Through Suffering, Strength
community_notes: If the bearer has lost one or more wounds, the bonus is +2 to each characteristic instead (escalation not encoded).

name: Chaplet of Sacrifice
community_notes: At the end of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, re-roll 1 Miracle dice from your pool and return it showing the new result; if the bearer's unit is below its Starting Strength, re-roll up to 3 Miracle dice instead.

name: Mantle of Ophelia
community_notes: Canoness or Palatine model only: each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 1.

name: Righteous Rage
community_notes: Each time the bearer is selected to fight, you can first discard up to 3 Miracle dice; the bonus is +1 Attacks and +1 Strength per die discarded.

name: Manual of Saint Griselda
community_notes: At the start of your Command phase, you can discard up to 2 Miracle dice; the gained Miracle dice shows a value equal to the sum of the discarded dice (maximum 6).

name: Fire and Fury
community_notes: Torrent weapons get +1 Attacks; all other ranged weapons in the led unit have [Sustained Hits 1].

name: Iron Surplice of Saint Istalela
community_notes: Canoness or Palatine model only.

name: Triptych of Judgement
community_notes: Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, you can ignore modifiers to that attack's BS/WS and/or modifiers to the Hit roll.

name: Mark of Devotion
community_notes: While the bearer's unit is Righteous, the bonus is +2 Attacks and +1 Damage instead (escalation not encoded).

name: Eyes of the Oracle
community_notes: The bearer's weapons have [Precision]; each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy Character model, you gain 1CP.

name: Litanies of Faith
community_notes: Canoness or Palatine model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, take a Leadership test for it; the Miracle dice is gained only if the test is passed (gate not encoded).

name: Blade of Saint Ellynor
community_notes: Each time the bearer fights, if one or more enemy models are destroyed by those attacks, you gain 1 Miracle dice (rider not encoded).

name: Divine Aspect
community_notes: In your Movement phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer; it must take a Battle-shock test. If the test is failed, you gain 1 Miracle dice (rider not encoded).

name: Triptych of the Macharian Crusade
community_notes: Applies only to saving throws substituted with an Act of Faith: that saving throw is successful irrespective of the value of the Miracle dice used.

name: Divine Miracle
community_notes: Upgrade for a Sanctuary Guardians Battle Sisters Squad unit: once per battle, at the start of any phase, the unit heals D3+2 wounds.

name: Righteous Fervour
community_notes: The bearer's melee attacks have +1 Damage; the bearer's unit adds 1 to Wound rolls for melee attacks.
